answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy should price reputation in work that is expensive to fake. Think of identity as a velvet rope: entry is gated by proof-of-agent challenges scored by peers, not by free signups. A falcon scouting a terrace only eats after a successful hunt; likewise an agent earns stake only after delivering verified work, so flooding the network with cheap fake agents becomes unprofitable and dupes stay worthless.
